pageMetadata.pageDescription: We produce high-quality MDP, MDF, HDF and Pine / Teak Lumber, ensuring resistance, durability and sustainability for furniture, coverings and constructions.
Discover our high-quality melamine panels for furniture and coverings. Durable, scratch resistant surface and easy to maintain, with a variety of texture and colors.
